item.title: Gas prices climb in Peoria, West Coast states see largest gains
item.description: Gas prices in the Peoria area rose 9.9 cents to an average of $2.94 a gallon, while the national average rose 1.2 cents to $2.84 a gallon, according to GasBuddy.

item.title: Fulton County Sheriff warns residents about impersonation scam
item.description: The Fulton County Sheriff's Office is warning residents of an impersonation scam where a scammer claims to be affiliated with the Fulton County Courthouse and requests immediate payment to release a family member from an ankle monitor or jail.

item.title: Archbishop Fulton Sheen's sainthood advances to beatification
item.description: The Peoria Diocese has announced that the Cause for Sainthood for Archbishop Fulton Sheen is ready to move forward to the Beatification phase, after the church recognized his life of heroic virtue and a verified miracle of the restoration of life of a stillborn baby.

item.title: 16-year-old found dead in Bloomington home, police investigate
item.description: A 16-year-old girl was found dead inside a Bloomington home, and police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the incident.

item.title: Peoria County early voting to begin Tuesday
item.description: Early voting in Peoria County was postponed due to a court case involving a gubernatorial candidate, but the Peoria County Election Commission has decided to move forward with the voting process after the judge's decision.

item.title: Gunshots and screams captured by Ring camera during deadly Peoria shooting
item.description: Stevie Linwood, Jr. is on trial for the murder of Jakaiden Rynearson and Zaneta Winters, after they were allegedly shot by Linwood in August 2024, with footage from a neighbor's Ring camera capturing the incident.

item.title: UPDATE: Police locate missing 6th grader
item.description: Illinois State University Police are searching for a missing 6th-grade boy, Miguel Contreras, who was last seen leaving Metcalf School on Monday at 5:30 p.m.

item.title: New category and recognition for Peoria Miss Juneteenth's founder
item.description: PEORIA, Ill. (WMBD) -- Brett Brooks, founder of Peoria's Miss Juneteenth Pageant, opened a new category for the pageant system at the beginning of Black History Month. item.title: Pekin residents oppose city council's data center proposal
item.description: Pekin City Council members faced a large group of constituents urging them to reverse a proposed data center, citing potential health impacts, noise pollution, and increased utility bills.

item.title: Senate Democratic candidates to face off in statewide debate on WGN
item.description: WGN News will host a debate on February 19 between the leading candidates for the Democratic Party nomination for U.S. Senator from Illinois, moderated by WGN News political editor Tahman Bradley and anchor/reporter Micah Materre.
